name: Costco Food Court (Logan & Draper, UT) Giant Plain Cheese Pizza Slice
whyItWorks: Enormous slice loaded with over 1.5 lbs of melted whole-milk mozzarella and mild tomato sauce. Soft dough digests easily in stable remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dab the top with a paper napkin to absorb excess surface oil before eating.
watchOuts: High in dairy mozzarella; dab surface oil
